sentences.en: The mean value of the frequency decreases with increasing amplitude.
sentences.zh: 频率的平均值随着振幅增加而减小。

sentences.en: Dogs can hear sounds at much higher frequencies than humans.
sentences.zh: 狗能听到的人类听不到的高频率声音。

sentences.en: The noise-cancelling is effective at both low and high frequencies.
sentences.zh: 这种降噪效果在低频和高频下都很好。

senses.zh: (某事发生可重复的)频率 - 经常发生，频繁 - (声波或无线电波的)振动频率；波段
